title: US 35 over Deer Creek | proposed 2026 replacement
source_note: Primary INDOT B-45063 / Des 1900048 proposed 2026 replacement, document 9721578. Source cover and plans describe a 115 ft new crossing; the associated 2025 NBI record describes the older 1931 bridge.
assumptions: Exterior visualization reconstruction of the named design state, not an as-built survey, structural rating or validated finite-element mesh.
No internal reinforcement, prestressing strands, embedded anchors or fabrication holes. Colors identify visualization layers; amber parts identify explicit approximations.
Source PDF page references always address drawings.pdf, an unchanged issued PDF. Supplemental historical pages are separately identified by document ID and local file.
Constructed interfaces and bearing contact checks establish geometric attachment only. Surveyed seats, actual camber, shim thicknesses and installed tolerances remain unknown.
Site terrain, channel solids, riprap individual stones, buried pile tips, full roadside guardrail terminals and nonstructural utility routing are omitted.
Local Z datum is the source flowline elevation 837.11 ft; geometry is not surveyed or georeferenced.
Straight nominal girder lines use a 75 mm center haunch. Nominal integral-bent seats are derived for visual contact; real support rotational restraint is not inferred from bearing display meshes.

source_index.note: Primary drawings.pdf is byte-for-byte identical to the issued source; no combined or newly authored PDF. Supplemental page numbers do not address the primary PDF.

completeness: Whole crossing reconstructed with unresolved detail (amber)

detail_coverage.detail: One 115 ft bearing span; all four dimensioned BT48x49 beams, 8 in deck, 15 degree right skew and full grade. North (Beam 1) is +Y, left of increasing station, and the north end of each bent is up-station (sheets 11, 13, 14; reflected in revision 1.2).

Both integral bents, 8 embedded source steel bearing assemblies, infill, wings and 12 hidden pile display stubs. Seat attachment and end copes remain approximate. Bents centred 7 in along their lines from the bridge centre line (sheet 13); integral concrete flush with the cap span face (sheet 15); wings 12 ft from the span-face corner to the tip (sheets 13, 17). Wing tops at the sheet 17 T/El. on the bent centre line, parallel to the grade; centre closure bays and back faces crowned (revision 1.2). Back strips over the 9 in pavement ledge with the slab bearing on them; closure bays stop at the deck end (sheets 15, 25; revision 1.3).

FC barrier, four approximate TFC transitions, skew-to-square approach slabs and nominal extension/drain envelopes. FC section per sheet 23 section A-A; approach slabs 18'-3"/17'-8" either side of the centre line, square ends at Sta. 1270+76.06 / 1272+43.94, crowned top. Revision 1.3: FC rails square-ended at the drawn butt joints (at the deck end at the acute corners); TFCs 15'-8", 2'-9" high, on the sheet 11 plan taper; acute-corner extensions 15'-10" x 1'-6"; 11 ft integral curbs at the obtuse corners; approach slabs cast against the deck end.
Actual girder camber, end copes, diaphragm designation conflict and exact stagger, buried pile tips, transition hardware, construction joints and site terrain.

known_deviations.deviation: The TFC plan outline, 15'-8" length, square ends, 2'-9" height and the FC section at the butt joint follow sheets 11 and 23, but the face between the butt joint and the vertical end is an interpolation: the sheet 11 toe line is followed exactly, with the 5 in lower slope removed first and then the 2 in upper batter, at the FC break heights of 3 in and 10 in. Terminal connector recesses, anchor bolts, chamfers and the end details are not modelled. At the obtuse corners (TFC_transition_-1_-1, TFC_transition_1_1) the last 0.235-0.296 m of the TFC lie beyond the deck end, over the bent ledge and partly beyond the back face of the bent, with no part under them (about 0.06 m2 of base each).
known_deviations.reason: The plan set gives only the plan outline (sheet 11 linework), the length and the height (sheets 11, 23), the butt-joint section (sheet 23 section A-A) and the curb starting at the TFC end (sheet 25). The transition's own sections, break heights, end details and its support beyond the deck end at the obtuse corners are in INDOT Standard Drawings E706-TTFC-01 to -03 and E706-CBRT-01 (sheet 23 notes 4 and 5), which are not part of this plan set; those standard drawings would settle it.

decisions.decision: 15'-8" at all four corners; the north-west and south-east TFCs end 0.235 m (front of the vertical end) to 0.296 m (rear) beyond the deck end.
decisions.reasoning: Sheet 6 (roadway, not to scale) gives the guardrail-transition ends at Sta. 1271+05.91 and 1272+14.07, about 0.5 ft short of a 15'-8" TFC at those corners. The bridge sheets govern the bridge railing: sheet 11 draws all four transitions 141.0 pt = 15'-8", sheet 23 draws them equal and bills 4 each of one standard item, sheet 6 matches the 15'-8" TFC within 0.05 ft at the acute corners (1270+80.83, 1272+39.16), and sheet 25 starts the curb 9 1/4" beyond the slab corner, at the 15'-8" TFC end within 0.1 mm.

decisions.decision: Inner end on the skewed deck end.
decisions.reasoning: Sheet 25 draws the 15'-10" x 1'-6" extension as a rectangle from the slab corner; a square inner end there would run into the deck triangle beyond the corner. Sheets 15 and 25 draw the RCBA cast against the deck end, so the extension is too.

decisions.decision: The schematic Type IA joint strips keep their station range and display size, centred on the deck end, and now lie 12 mm into the deck and 12 mm into the approach slab.
decisions.reasoning: The joint is a sealed saw cut at the top of the contact face (sheets 15, 25); its size is in E 609-BRJT-01, not in this plan set. The strip only marks the joint line, which does not move.

decisions.decision: The 1/2" x 4" and 1/2" x 2" expanded polystyrene are not modelled; the 14 in slab bears directly on the ledge.
decisions.reasoning: The polystyrene is joint filler (bond breaker), not a void; its 13 mm thickness would only add sliver parts.

decisions.decision: The 9 in + 1'-6" thickened length and the 2 in 45 deg return of the sheet 25 pavement ledge detail are taken normal to the deck end, 0.7100 m and 0.7626 m along X.
decisions.reasoning: The detail's "9 in Min." ledge is the 9 in normal ledge of the 3'-10" bent (sheet 15), so the detail is drawn normal to the joint; the thickening runs across the full slab and extension width. The obtuse-corner curbs keep the 12 in slab bottom of their own sheet 25 detail.

kept_deviations.missing: The TFC plan outline, 15'-8" length, square ends, 2'-9" height and the FC section at the butt joint follow sheets 11 and 23, but the face between the butt joint and the vertical end is an interpolation: the sheet 11 toe line is followed exactly, with the 5 in lower slope removed first and then the 2 in upper batter, at the FC break heights of 3 in and 10 in. Terminal connector recesses, anchor bolts, chamfers and the end details are not modelled. At the obtuse corners (TFC_transition_-1_-1, TFC_transition_1_1) the last 0.235-0.296 m of the TFC lie beyond the deck end, over the bent ledge and partly beyond the back face of the bent, with no part under them (about 0.06 m2 of base each).
kept_deviations.settled_by: INDOT Standard Drawings E706-TTFC-01 to -03 and E706-CBRT-01
